newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Petrovietnam's 1996 crude output set for record.
newsitem.headline: Petrovietnam's 1996 crude output set for record.

text.p: Petrovietnam, Vietnam's state-owned oil and gas company, pumped a record 8.46 million tonnes of crude between January 1 and December 22, official media reports said on Tuesday.
The Vietnam News Agency said crude oil output from the Bach Ho (White Tiger), Rong (Dragon) and Dai Hung (Big Bear) fields was 146,000 tonnes higher than the target for the whole year.
Reported output in 1995 was 7.7 million tonnes.
The news agency said crude oil exports for the whole year were expected to be 8.6 million tonnes, earning $1.36 billion, $250 million more than originally targeted.
